entries.name: tooltip_evaluation
comments: ### - `legacy` - Previous behaviour that is similar to `eval` but a lot less predictable. Using this explicitly is very likely a bug
### - `no_eval` - If you have no random parts or side effects, then this will give you a slightly faster computation of the tooltip.
### - `eval` - Standard evalulation of the trigger. This is most likely what you need if you have a trigger that has side effects or random parts.
### There are three possible evaluation techniques to use when computing tooltips for hidden_triggers
### - The trigger uses random numbers (e.g. acts on a random state)
### - The trigger has a side effect (e.g. temporary variables).
